events.verdict: LAR shows Kanter (NYK) jumps A to B and makes body contact with Ingram (LAL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
McGee (LAL) makes marginal contact with Knox's (NYK) front after the release of his driving shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Ball (LAL) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
After making initial contact with the ball, Hart's (LAL) hand slides off and makes slight contact with Hezonja's (NYK) right arm, but it does not affect his ability to gain control of the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Hezonja's (NYK) right foot is out of bounds when the ball makes contact with his body.
McGee (LAL) makes clean contact with the ball as he dislodges it from Kanter (NYK).
[Observable in enhanced video] Hart (LAL) slides his pivot foot after gaining control of the rebound.
Kanter (NYK) sets the pick on Caldwell-Pope (LAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
McGee (LAL) makes contact with the ball after it hits the backboard.

Hart (LAL) makes marginal contact with Mudiay (NYK) after his gather. Additionally, multiple angles were reviewed to determine whether or not Hart makes contact with Mudiay's head after his gather, but there is no clear and conclusive video evidence.

Mudiay (NYK) slightly extends his off-arm and makes contact with McGee's (LAL) head/neck area. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Chandler (LAL) sets the screen on Knox (NYK) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Hart (LAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Knox (NYK) makes incidental foot-to-foot contact with Hart (LAL) after they both return to the floor following the shot attempt.
Hart (LAL) commits the take foul on Hezonja (NYK).
